svg.title: How content flows
svg.desc: Storyblok sends published content to the tagged Next.js cache, drafts to authenticated preview, and publish webhooks to cache invalidation. Cache and preview feed React Server Components for English and German pages. Published Markdown and the block schema JSON catalog feed read-only agent tools.
